formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.ATR: Wilder RMA of true range=max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close))
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.Supertrend: HL2 +/- multiplier*WilderATR recursive final-band construction; continuous risk=(active_supertrend-close)/ATR
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.Chandelier: rolling high L - multiplier*WilderATR(L); continuous risk=(exit-close)/ATR
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.RSI_divergence: within-window standardized OLS slope(log close,L) minus within-window standardized OLS slope(RSI_L,L)
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.PPO_divergence: 20-session standardized OLS slope(log close) minus 20-session standardized OLS slope(PPO) for each preregistered PPO geometry
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.failed_up_break: at t, close[t-1] exceeds rolling-high range ending t-2 and close[t] returns to/below that same pre-break range
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.MFI: typical-price money flow with sign from typical-price change
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.CMF: standard close-location-value times volume rolling ratio
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.F24_interactions: positive part of each preregistered base-family causal-z family score multiplied pairwise, then independently causal-z normalized
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.causal_z: rolling 252 including current t, minimum 60, ddof=1, clip [-3,3], zero variance missing
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.family_score: equal-weight mean of preregistered cell z-scores with at least ceil(60% of family cells) present
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.bootstrap_rank: average-tie ranks standardized once on full common panel; resamples do not rerank
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.moving_block_bootstrap: aligned contiguous block length 60; ceil(N/60) sampled blocks; final block truncated to N; 4000 reps; seed 620062; Type-7 q95
formula_choices_frozen_before_historical.simultaneous_control: single q95 of max across 34 observed-track-min minus bootstrap-track-min differences; LCB=observed_min-q95
